fields.role: The job title or function of the personnel.
fields.operational_phase: The current stage of plant operation.
fields.authorization: The level of access or permission granted.
fields.membrane_feed_pressure: The pressure measured at the membrane feed.
fields.threshold_type: The classification of the alert or trip level.
fields.value: The specific numeric value associated with a threshold or measurement.
fields.parameter_tag: The unique identifier for the instrument or stream.
fields.measurement: The type of physical property being measured.
fields.metric_unit: The unit of measure for the parameter.
fields.min_bound: The lower limit of an acceptable range.
fields.max_bound: The upper limit of an acceptable range.
fields.required_correction: The corrective action needed to return a parameter to range.
fields.time_allowance: The permitted duration to resolve an issue or perform a task.
fields.action: The required response or result triggered by a condition.
fields.condition: The narrative trigger or event that activates a rule.
fields.requirement: A mandatory operational or safety instruction.
fields.high_pressure_intake_pump_ramp_up_maximu: The maximum allowed rate of pressure increase for the intake pump.
fields.anti_scalant_dosing_pump_status: The required state of the anti-scalant pump.
fields.permeate_bypass_valve_status: The required state of the permeate bypass valve.
fields.brine_reject_flow_logging_frequency: How often the brine reject flow must be recorded.
fields.consequence: The result or impact of a specific event.
fields.regulatory_compliance: The legal or regulatory mandate for data or process handling.

categories.AccessRequirement: Requirements regarding personnel access and authorization.
categories.OperationalLimit: Limits related to plant operational parameters.
categories.WaterQualityLimit: Limits related to water chemistry and quality.
categories.RampRateLimit: Limits on the speed of parameter changes.
categories.StartupSequenceRequirement: Requirements for the order of startup operations.
categories.StartupOperationalRequirement: General requirements during the startup phase.
categories.StartupFailureResponse: Actions to take when startup fails.
categories.DisposalProcedure: Procedures for waste or container disposal.
categories.DiagnosticProcedure: Procedures for system diagnostics and analysis.
